## [1.4.0](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-10-18)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Eyecon:** fold premium-screen cleanups into Unlock premium, default Remove premium tab ([b1ace7c](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/commit/b1ace7c91ffc86516a71138c7b42d2c6e5a43f5f))

### ✨ New Features

* **Eyecon:** fix premium display, add AMOLED theme and premium-tab patches ([473f3aa](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/commit/473f3aa1e77af6d1a418ff5b3f41680b8c6b4439)), closes [#19232f](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/19232f) [#060f1b](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/060f1b) [#07111e](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/07111e) [#062224](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/062224) [#000104](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/000104) [#343e53](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/343e53) [#22323c](https://github.com/sabbirexist/kodex-patches/issues/22323c)

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Repaints the dark theme's background, cards, bars and dialogs to true black for AMOLED screens.

patches.name: Block contact upload
patches.description: Stops Eyecon from uploading your contacts to its server for caller ID.

patches.name: Block tracking & analytics
patches.description: Disables Amplitude (including Session Replay screen recording), Singular attribution and Crashlytics crash reporting.

patches.name: Remove premium tab
patches.description: Hides the premium tab from the home bottom bar.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks every premium feature client-side: removes ads, unlocks themes, premium caller ID and after-call screen, call recording, SMS extras, reverse lookup and ID Plus.

patches.name: AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Repaints every dark surface — background, cards, dialogs, popups, header and the navigation bar — to true black.

patches.name: Disable audio time-stretch
patches.description: Forces time-stretching off for artifact-free playback at 1x speed.

patches.name: Force AAudio output
patches.description: Locks the audio output to AAudio (low latency), overriding the device preference.

patches.name: Force ReplayGain
patches.description: Normalizes loudness across tracks using track mode with peak protection.

patches.name: Force audio passthrough
patches.description: Enables bitstream audio passthrough (digital output) to an external DAC or receiver.

patches.name: Raise network cache
patches.description: Buffers 3 seconds of stream ahead to reduce stalls on flaky networks.

patches.name: Skip "What's New" dialog
patches.description: Suppresses the What's New changelog dialog shown after app updates.

patches.name: Unlock experimental features
patches.description: Enables every experimental feature flag regardless of its stored value.

patches.name: Verbose libVLC logging
patches.description: Sets libVLC to maximum verbosity (-vvv) for troubleshooting playback.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Unlocks the paid Remove Ads feature: disables every ad and hides the Remove Ads purchase icon.
